prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
Great question — “best” depends on what you need. A few quick clarifying items will let me give a targeted recommendation:

Questions
- Do you need a full-service agency (brand strategy, creative, PR, digital, paid media) or a specialty (SEO, paid search, social, content, physician recruitment)?
- Who is the client: hospital system, private practice, clinic, medical device, pharma, biotech, or health-tech startup?
- Rough budget and timeline?
- Do you prefer a local St. Louis firm or are remote/national agencies okay?
- Any must-haves (HIPAA experience, patient acquisition, B2B sales, clinical trial recruiting, Spanish-language marketing, analytics/attribution)?

What I can do next
- If you reply with the above, I’ll shortlist 3–6 agencies in St. Louis that match your needs, with strengths, typical clients, pricing ballpark, and questions to ask each.
- Or I can list general criteria and a quick vendor-evaluation checklist you can use right away.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
